tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.13
§ Adonikam = "my lord arose"
the head of an Israelite clan who returned from exile

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Adonikam, the name of one or two Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H6965 (קוּם); lord of rising (i.e. high);
